purpose: Preserved diagnostic source and post-run identity inventory of the currently served composition probe. Not a release acceptance or OS IME result.

build.server_owner: Temporary local Python HTTP server started for this diagnostic; root task controls the browser and server lifetime.

renderer_resource_resolution.note: Generated loader uses the engine-versioned CanvasKit CDN by default. Local build artifact inventory is not a capture of actual browser network responses or cached renderer bytes.

current_dependency_context.patch_note: Post-run current beautiful_ai_ui library changes relative to the recorded HEAD. Catalog main/driver/test edits are not imported by this probe.

limits: Source matches the SHA in the visible-observation record. Artifact/dependency inventory was taken after the run, not by a contemporaneous build-time source freeze.
The earlier direct-Dart-only bundle was overwritten and was not separately hashed or retained. Its observations are retained only with that stated boundary.
The archived final source supports both controls and both injection modes; replaying it creates a new build and new observations.
Compiled files stay in ignored build output; this manifest preserves their names, sizes and current SHA-256 identities without adding generated engine/fonts to the repository.
Browser identification is limited to the recorded Codex in-app browser surface; no OS input-method session was exercised.
Synthetic DOM events are untrusted. No framework gate was replaced or skipped and no OS IME success/failure is asserted.
